shipped_row.boundary_rationale: This unit is bounded by a dramatic question-and-answer frame: the prophetic voice opens with a verse-initial interrogative, מִי זֶ֣ה בָּ֣א מֵאֱד֗וֹם (oshb:Isa.63.1, byte tier), “Who is this who comes from Edom” (web:Isa.63.1); the clause that follows opens instead on a bare demonstrative, זֶ֚ה הָד֣וּר בִּלְבוּשׁ֔וֹ (oshb:Isa.63.1, byte tier), rendered as a second question, “Who is this who is glorious in his clothing,” only in the English witness. The same first-person divine-warrior voice continues in unbroken speech through the vengeance-and-treading report, closing the unit at “I poured their lifeblood out on the earth.” (web:Isa.63.6). The unit ends there because 63:7 pivots to a different speaker and a different speech-act: a first-person-plural recital of Yahweh's mercies replaces the divine warrior's own first-person report, with no further interrogative sustaining the dialogue frame.
